---
id: BB-OBJ-1
title: Expand shared-umbrella coverage to every transit stop
node_type: objective
evidence_strength: source_grounded
measurable_target: 40 lending stations live across the pilot city by month 12
responsible_partner: BorrowBrella core team
---

Place a self-service umbrella-lending stand at every major transit stop in the
pilot city so that no commuter is more than a short walk from a borrowable
umbrella when the weather turns.
